claims.text: The Harbor View Hotel is in Edgartown, on Martha's Vineyard, about 7 miles off the coast of Massachusetts.

findings.quote: The Harbor View Hotel located in Edgartown, on Martha’s Vineyard, captures the essence of the Great American Summer. Situated just 7 miles off the coast of Massachusetts

claims.text: The hotel is steps from Fuller and Lighthouse Beaches, shopping in Edgartown Village and the natural habitat of Chappaquiddick Island.

findings.quote: steps away from Fuller and Lighthouse Beaches, shopping in Edgartown Village and the natural habitat of Chappaquiddick Island.

claims.text: The Harbor View Hotel opened in July 1891.

findings.quote: The Week of the Harbor View's opening in July 1891.
July 23rd, 1891, to be exact.

claims.text: The hotel was restored and redesigned in 2019.

findings.quote: Faithfully restored. Beautifully redesigned. Proudly reimagined in 2019.

claims.text: Guests choose between three building types: the grand historic building, The Roxana and the Captain's Cottages.

findings.quote: Choose between three high end, bespoke resort building types. There’s the legendary grand historic building (don’t be surprised to spot a celebrity); The Roxana
Providing even more of a private atmosphere are the Captain’s Cottages

claims.text: Every room has Frette linens, a Nespresso coffee machine, robes, WiFi and wireless speakers.

findings.quote: Every Harbor View Hotel room offers luxe bath products, Frette linens, Nespresso Coffee machines, luxe robes, WiFi, and wireless speakers.

claims.text: The hotel has a heated, saltwater outdoor pool, a fitness center and bicycles for guest use.

findings.quote: Guests can enjoy the heated, saltwater, outdoor pool, fitness center, beautiful outdoor spaces, spectacular ocean views, close vicinity to town, and bicycles for guest use.

claims.text: The hotel's Veranda overlooks Edgartown Harbor.

findings.quote: The Veranda Overlooking Edgartown Harbor

claims.text: Couples say their vows on the hotel's Great Lawn.

findings.quote: Couples say vows on our Great Lawn.

claims.text: Bettini Restaurant serves contemporary American cuisine, with expansive windows onto the coastal view.

findings.quote: Bettini, an upscale, fine-dining restaurant offering refined contemporary American cuisine
Expansive windows reveal a magnificent coastal view

claims.text: Behind The View has harbor views and access to an outdoor veranda.

findings.quote: With harbor views and access to an outdoor veranda, the restaurant captures the waterfront charm of Harbor View Hotel.

claims.text: The fourth-floor Presidential Skyhouse Wing looks over the Atlantic Ocean, Edgartown Harbor, Edgartown Lighthouse and Chappaquiddick Island.

findings.quote: Soaring over the Atlantic Ocean, Edgartown Harbor, Edgartown Lighthouse and Chappaquiddick Island, the fourth floor Presidential Skyhouse Wing

claims.text: The hotel overlooks Edgartown Lighthouse, Edgartown Harbor and the Atlantic Ocean.

findings.quote: Holding court over Edgartown Lighthouse, the Harbor and the Atlantic Ocean, the Harbor View Hotel offers stunning views

claims.text: The Captain's Cottages are stand-alone Victorian homes with one to three bedrooms, kitchenettes and living rooms, set along a blossom-filled walkway.

findings.quote: the Captain’s Cottages, stand-alone, fully-equipped and elegant Victorian homes.
Sprinkled along a blossom-filled walkway, the Captain’s Cottages
Ranging from one to three bedrooms with kitchenettes and living rooms

claims.text: In 1975 Steven Spielberg and the cast and crew of Jaws stayed on an entire floor of the hotel.

findings.quote: a young director by the name of Steven Spielberg and the cast and crew of “Jaws” resided on an entire floor at the hotel in 1975.

claims.text: The Roxana is named after owner Bernard Chiu's daughter, and its balconies overlook the pool scene and Edgartown Village.

findings.quote: The Roxana, named after the owner Bernard Chiu’s daughter
Balcony vistas overlook the lively pool scene and Edgartown Village.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes Martha's Vineyard is a seasonal destination with limited winter availability.
WhataHotel notes the island location requires ferry transportation.
